origin: an invented requirements list that uses other ID schemes (FR-1, REQ-10, NFR-1) in headings, a table and bullets, to try the spec's own ID rule (D5) on a real model

requirements.start: A recipient collects a parcel by typing the six-digit code
If a parcel is not collected within 72 hours
The locker shows its own address and opening hours
A carrier opens every compartment of a locker with one scan
Lockers keep working for 48 hours without a network connection
NFR-1: a recipient completes collection in under 20 seconds
NFR-2: the notification message reaches the recipient within 60 seconds

not_requirements: The pilot starts in three cities.

clarifications.topic: FR-3 oversize notice: required for the pilot or not
clarifications.anchor: The system should tell the carrier before they travel
Anja will ask legal whether we may keep recipients' phone numbers for 30 days.
